text.p: General Motors Corp. said Monday it is issuing a voluntary safety recall of about 390,000 vehicles to install a new windscreen washer/wiper switch.
Affected cars include the model year 1994 Pontiac Grand Prix, 1994-95 Buick Regal and Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme, and 1995 Chevrolet Lumina and Monte Carlo.
Customers will be notified by mail to take their vehicles to their dealer for the necessary repairs. All vehicles will be repaired at no cost to the customer.

Some of the subject vehicles may contain a strained or separated power feed wire that may cause the windscreen washer/wiper to work intermittently. Dealers will inspect the washer/wiper switch and replace switches of an old design with a new switch.
No injuries or accidents have been reported as a result of this condition, General Motors said.
